summary: Fresh re-review of the node revised after the prior 'split' of the empty story (old fingerprint 7c7628...). ST-06 is now a well-decomposed, non-empty story with 7 direct children. Decomposition is sound: three parallel band-identity leaves (WI-06a surface+coast identity plus the section 59 cozy baseline/return relief, WI-06b mid bands, WI-06c deep bands+final zone plus the section 16 scale-reveal zoom, inspected spoiler-safe per section 70), two story children for the oversized areas (WI-06d geometry replacement / section 48 juice / section 16 shake+widescreen, and WI-06e depth audio, each further decomposed into verified non-empty sub-stories whose frontmatter child ids all resolve on disk), and two focused leaves (WI-06f section 26 bathymetry map, WI-06g section 43 a11y controls). All 6 parent criteria (AC-art-palettes/sound/geometry/contrast/map/a11y) are preserved verbatim across the children and their union covers every parent criterion (coverage: true). Dependencies are correct and acyclic: the three band leaves are parallel; WI-06d and WI-06e depend on all three band passes (juice/geometry tuned against the settled look, audible-before-visible lead time measured against final band visibility); WI-06f and WI-06g depend on WI-04b (ST-04, which exists and is reviewed); WI-06g additionally depends on WI-06d, which per the story-dependency rule means all its leaves and matches its need to gate the WI-06d-c shake flag and consume WI-06d-b flash sources. Final proof ownership is named for every shared criterion (palettes -> WI-06d subtree, geometry -> WI-06d subtree, sound -> WI-06e subtree, contrast -> WI-06a, map -> WI-06f, a11y -> WI-06g), each traceable down to a proving leaf. Non-blocking observations: (1) the parent frontmatter subsystem list declares 4 subsystems but omits 'camera', a real changed subsystem in WI-06d-c (covered in the narrative scope inventory and in WI-06d's own frontmatter, which lists it); (2) palettes/geometry/sound name a story as final-proof-owner, which delegates one level down to the proving leaf (WI-06d-b, WI-06d-a, WI-06e-c respectively) - a valid nested-tree pattern, so traceability holds. Neither blocks readiness; the story is correctly shaped and its leaves stand alone for fresh implementers.
